name: Slice Reality
body:
School evocation; Level magus 2, occultist 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2, witchwarper 2; void elemental school 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target 1 creature + 1 creature/3 levels
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You expose targets to churning entropy which turns parts of their body sickly and black. This spell affects all types of creatures, including undead and constructs. Each target takes 2d6 damage. A successful Fortitude save halves this damage.

You can instead focus on only one target rather than multiple. If you target only a single creature with this spell, the target is also staggered for a number of rounds equal to your caster level.
